scope: v5.0 Arena session lifecycle implementation; isolated workspace only

also_changed.ownership: only Arena fake /api/manifest response; parent owns concurrent app tests

architecture: ModelClient receives current text only. No previous transcript or user-reported observation is inserted into model input.
execution manifest validation occurs before inference; evaluate_current + local user-review/LinkGuard layers execute before session prior_pause policy.
default server policy legacy; --policy dra is explicit comparison. Request body cannot choose policy.
execution_trace current-turn conditions/rules remain separate from execution_trace.session. Condition observed is not automatically a rule applied.
prior_pause remains latched after a PAUSE. A later non-PAUSE current turn yields session ASK_HUMAN/PRIOR_RISK_UNRESOLVED.
OPEN -> CLOSED_UNRESOLVED -> OPEN changes lifecycle/version, never clears risk or deletes history. No clearance operation exists.
close/reopen/evaluate share request ID namespace and optimistic session version. Exact cached retries return their historical event, not the current session state.
model inference occurs outside the SQLite write transaction. A close or competing update during inference invalidates late commit.
read envelope, task list and events use one SQLite read transaction snapshot.

open tasks are reused; completed user reports remain related_task when only prior-risk hold persists. Identical PAUSE text after its completed report does not create duplicate task. New risk text or stronger CAUTION->PAUSE creates a new task.
NOT_CHECKED means no new report and does not overwrite UNRESOLVED.
UI shows session lifecycle/risk, current-text action and user-reported task separately; closure/reload/input changes invalidate current result binding.
browser stores only visited opaque session identifiers and current identifier; selection can restore previously opened retained records without inference.

api.GET /api/manifest: active server policy, versioned execution contract, lifecycle capabilities
consistent session/tasks/events snapshot; no raw text, quoted evidence or full URLs
api.POST /api/reopen: same controls -> OPEN with prior risk/tasks retained
api.POST /api/evaluate: existing controls and current text + optional user_review/consent; closed new evaluations return409 before inference
api.broken_manifest: static503 EXECUTION_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE for ContractError/OSError/ValueError/KeyError/TypeError in preflight; no user text/error details reflected

database.migration: transactional additive migration from v4.9 user_version=0: sessions.lifecycle, tasks.trigger_fingerprint, tasks.trigger_action. Original events/digests remain exact. Future schema rejected. Failed migration rolls back DDL and version.
database.default_path: runs/arena.sqlite3; --db can select an isolated database
database.backup: Stop only the instance using the chosen DB and back up that SQLite database before operator reuse/migration. No backup of or deletion from existing user databases was performed by this agent.
database.retention: close is retention, never deletion. No delete HTTP endpoint. Browser localStorage cleanup removes navigation IDs only, not SQLite records.
database.deletion: Operator-managed DB/file deletion after stopping the specific instance, if separately desired; not performed. SQLite data is not encrypted/tamper-proof and user reports are not independently verified.
database.new_persistence: decision probabilities, offset/kind evidence, safe execution trace, local link summary, keyed HMACs and user report enum only. Detailed LinkGuard payload, raw input, model response, quote, URLs excluded.
database.legacy_limits: Migration preserves historical events exactly and cannot retroactively add v5 traces or prove past data hygiene. No model recalculation during migration.

loopback_scope.real_model_client: validated on construction and immediately before infer; only localhost/127.0.0.1 HTTP(S) /v1/systemone paths. Userinfo/query/hash/invalid port rejected before host scope. Remote allowlist/consent environment flags cannot broaden v5 release scope. Vendor bridge unchanged.
loopback_scope.test_clients: explicit synthetic clients bypass transport validation; zero actual model calls by this agent
loopback_scope.public_generation: separate existing fixed localhost generation comparison route, never applied as policy/session decision

future schema leaves file bytes unchanged; corrupt key rolls back added tables/columns
HTTP server recreated using same DB preserves latch/task/history; this is in-process server reconstruction, not an OS process restart claim
manifest failure classes produce static HTTP503, infer count zero, version unchanged
synthetic unique text/token/URL not present in state JSON or SQLite bytes
Node tests cover closure controls, reload without new session, prior record selection, input/review/policy stale response, and reported task presentation

additional_full_v49_regression.overlap: Includes 14 earlier narrow Python regressions; do not sum with55 as independent tests.

limitations: New model quality/calibration is not established by lifecycle tests; independent real-model experiments are coordinated separately.
No independent institution verification or risk clearance is implemented; user reports remain USER_REPORTED.
Historical events remain distinct from current-input guidance. Browser ID history belongs to that browser/origin; clearing storage removes convenient retrieval IDs, not server history.
All work is synthetic-only and advisory. No calls, money transfer, browser generation, external reputation, or remote model request was performed by this agent.

trace_fingerprints.execution_trace.session.input_fingerprin: Historical field name: HMAC of the complete normalized request (version, text, task ID, observation and any effective local review/consent options), NOT text-only.
trace_fingerprints.tasks.trigger_fingerprint: Separate keyed text-only fingerprint used internally for task deduplication; excluded from GET task objects.
trace_fingerprints.clarification: No claim of cross-request identical-text equality is made for input_fingerprint; unchanged text with a new version produces a different request HMAC.

broader_regression_followup.cause: Full unittest discovery imports release tools that prepend tools/ to global sys.path. Lazy import linkguard then resolves tools/linkguard/ instead of product linkguard/. apply_local_layers follows its intentional LOCAL_LINKGUARD_NOT_AVAILABLE fail-closed path. Reproduced by full discovery then isolated case; narrow session suites passed because tools were not imported.
broader_regression_followup.fix_recommendation: Release tool imports should use package-relative imports when imported and avoid globally prepending tools/; no policy threshold or manifest change needed. Root informed; no out-of-owner source edit made.
broader_regression_followup.fix: verify_release,delivery_gate,verify_apk use package-relative imports when imported, bare sibling imports for direct CLI whose script directory is already on sys.path. No global sys.path mutation. Product/contract source unchanged.

validation.test_boundary: Fresh Python subprocess preserves sys.path and resolves product linkguard. verify_release/verify_apk --help plus delivery_gate usage work through script and -m entrypoints. Existing release fail-closed fixture tests remain included.
